enc.description: Obfuscation scheme for the body. 'b64' = base64 of UTF-8 bytes.

body.description: Base64-obfuscated message text (UTF-8 bytes, base64-encoded). Obfuscation only, not encryption.

convoId.description: Deterministic 1:1 conversation id = sha256(sorted([didA, didB]).join('|')). Both parties derive the same id without coordination.

main.description: A single chat message, written to the SENDER's repo. The body is base64-obfuscated (NOT encrypted) so it isn't plainly readable when browsing the repo, but it is not secret — anyone can decode it. Chats are public on the user's PDS. The convoId groups a 1:1 conversation. Carries the app.zeens.v marker so the firehose recognises it.
